title: Progress
description: A rule that fills rather than a container that drains, with a static dashed indeterminate state

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label linked to the native progress element.

props.name: value
props.description: Finite progress value, clamped between zero and max. Omit it, or supply a nonfinite value, for the indeterminate state.

props.name: max
props.description: Positive finite maximum; defaults to 100 and falls back to 100 for invalid values.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Displayed value text; otherwise uses a rounded percentage or Unknown for indeterminate progress.

props.name: quiet
props.description: Use the quieter progress fill; defaults to false.

props.name: thick
props.description: Use the thicker track; defaults to false.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes on the label/progress wrapper. className and ref target the progress element.
